info.description:
Document-intelligence API: upload invoices, track processing, review and correct
extracted fields, reconcile documents and search.

**Auth**: `Authorization: Bearer <api key>` on every route except `/health/*`.
**Errors**: RFC 9457 `application/problem+json`. **Money**: decimal strings. See docs/api.md.

get.description: keyword: full text over document chunks ("phrases", OR, -exclusion) plus invoice number, supplier and customer matches. semantic: vector similarity. hybrid (default): both, fused with Reciprocal Rank Fusion. Same filters as GET /documents. If the query can't be embedded (quota, outage), semantic and hybrid return keyword results with degraded=true. Snippets are structured text segments, never HTML. Stricter rate limit (SEARCH_RPM): semantic queries spend embedding quota.
